'''Abara Mun''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Police officer/Legends|detention officer]] who ran the [[Treema Courthouse and Detention Area]] in [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Treema]]. In [[44 ABY]], she met with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Gavar Khai]] regarding their children, [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Vestara Khai]]'s detainment, as well as the detainment of [[Dyon Stadd]].
